title: P14 line-identity negative control ran on a partial scratch copy and was vacuous
what_went_wrong: p14_line_negctl.sh copied databarang into the scratch DB with INSERT ... SELECT; strict sql_mode rejected a '0000-00-00' expire date (ERROR 1292), the copy failed, and the script continued.
With an empty databarang every drug line became UNMAPPED, so NC (b) and (c) could not discriminate; the unplanted run already failed.
root_cause: The scratch build did not check its own result (no exit-code or row-count check), i.e. fail-open setup inside a fail-closed control.
detection: The control's own judge: P14-LINE-NC: NOT-DISCRIMINATING (evidence/p14/post_attempt1_nc_vacuous.log).
impact: No false claim: the control reported NOT-DISCRIMINATING. Cost one clone rebuild and fixture re-run (~3 min).

correction.applied: Copy with SET SESSION sql_mode=''; abort exit 3 on copy error or when any copied table's row count differs from its source.
correction.result: Re-run DISCRIMINATING: (a) same-price swap DIFFER with component delta {}, (b) DIFFER, (c) AMBIGUOUS, ROW_COUNT()=1 each (evidence/p14/nc_rerun.log).

rule: Every scratch or fixture build step in a control asserts its own row counts before the control runs.
